label: Sector ETF Lagging the Market Snapback
about: A sector or index ETF in an uptrend that has fallen at least 3 points more than SPY over the last five sessions and is short-term oversold. Relative underperformance of a whole sector inside a bull market tends to close; buy the laggard and target its 4-day mean.

source.title: Relative-strength mean reversion between sectors (sector rotation literature; e.g. Fidelity sector rotation primer)

label: Friday Dip, Weekend Bounce
about: Uptrend stock or ETF that is short-term oversold at Friday's close. Buying ahead of the weekend captures the Monday-Tuesday reversal that short-term studies find after weak Fridays; sell on a close above the 5-day average.

source.title: Day-of-week reversal effects in short-term mean reversion (Quantified Strategies: Monday reversal / weekend effect tests)

label: Pullback in a Strong Trend (ADX)
about: Stock in a strong, established trend (ADX above 30, above a rising 50-day that is above the 200-day) gets a sharp two-day pullback. Strong trends absorb pullbacks fast; buy the dip and target the 7-day closing high.

source.title: ADX trend strength plus pullback entries (Wilder, New Concepts in Technical Trading Systems, 1978)
